_comment: This title's own material-input vocabulary. Its surfaces are authored in a node editor whose normal input is spelled differently from the engine's own, which is why the engine-wide layer underneath does not name it. Only what a name states unambiguously is filed here: the masks and ramps this title's own lighting uses have no meaning outside it and stay in the panel's Unmapped Textures list, which is where a person says what they are.
